name: Stampezee
summary: Digital stamp cards for local businesses, replacing paper punch cards. Public pricing stays thin, so re-check the tiers before committing.
best_for: local businesses (cafés, salons, retail) that want a simple digital stamp-card loyalty program starting free
skip_if: you need POS-integrated loyalty with CRM depth (bigger platforms exist), or your offer isn't repeat-visit shaped
honest_knock: The category is honest and proven (digital stamp cards beat lost paper cards), and the platform is young with limited public pricing and review coverage — so start on the free plan, run one real campaign, and measure repeat-visit lift before paying. The deeper truth of loyalty programs: the mechanics are 10% of the outcome; a reward worth returning for is the other 90%.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-08-30 on stampezee.com/en/pricing from a US exit) Four tiers, all now named and priced on the public page. Stamp Start free: 1 branch, 1 stamp card, up to 100 customers or 100 stamps, whichever comes first. Stamp Lite $29.99/month: 2 branches, 3 stamp cards, unlimited customers and stamps, signup rewards, EzeeCodes, birthday/anniversary/referral automations. Stamp Pro $49.99: 3 branches, 6 cards, spend-based stamping, tiered and exclusive rewards, 4 push notifications. Stamp Elite $99.99: 10 branches, 12 cards, scratch-card campaigns, email marketing, 1 custom stamp card design, dedicated account manager. The page advertises 17% off on the annual term but does not print the annual amounts. StampEzee prices by region and the European rates are materially lower, not just relabelled: the same page read from the Netherlands gives EUR 19.99, 39.99 and 69.99. Note the entry tier's own contradiction: the plan card frames Stamp Start as a 14-day free trial, the comparison table on the same page lists it as Free with no time limit.

free_plan_evidence: Stamp Start free: 1 branch, 1 stamp card, up to 100 customers or 100 stamps, whichever comes first.
